entities.name: Shaila's Claim
entities.description: A historic greenway on the edge of Ghirapur, preserved because a shepherd refused to leave her grazing land.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A city on Kaladesh designed largely by elves according to the teachings of the Great Conduit.

entities.name: Shaila
entities.description: A human shepherd who refused to give up her grazing land to the Consulate and was granted the right to stay.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The governing authority of Kaladesh, led by the Enlightened Keepers.

entities.name: Enlightened Keepers
entities.description: The leaders of the Consulate, before whom Shaila demanded an audience.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: The source of teachings by which Ghirapur's designers shaped the city's expansion.

entities.name: Narnam House
entities.description: A notorious underground greenhouse at the fringe of Shaila's Claim, centre of a hidden trade in poisons and murderous automatons.

entities.name: Djarin
entities.description: A human woman who owns Narnam House and raises her large family there.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane on which Ghirapur lies.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A region of Kaladesh whose deadliest plants are grown at Narnam House.

events.summary: Builders reached Shaila's hillock and wanted it for an advisor's mansion, but Shaila refused to yield.
Shaila demanded and won an audience with the Enlightened Keepers, who granted her the right to remain on the land in perpetuity.
events.quote: She demanded an audience with the Enlightened Keepers themselves.

events.summary: Djarin runs Narnam House, selling poisons and murderous automatons to blindfolded clients.
events.quote: Clients who wish to purchase her deadly wares are blindfolded and guided inside by her many children

relations.quote: Owned by a human woman named Djarin
Hidden at the fringe of Shaila's Claim lies the notorious Narnam House .

relations.note: on the edge of the city
relations.quote: Shaila's Claim is a historic greenway on the edge of Ghirapur
